try.question: Two counters and three counters make how many?
try.explanation: Count both groups together: one, two, three, four, five.

try.question: Three counters, take one away. How many remain?
try.explanation: One counter was removed. Count the two that are left.

try.question: Which group has more counters?
try.explanation: Match two counters from each group. The group of four still has two extra.

steps.text: Listen to the sound at the start.

try.question: Which word rhymes with cat?
try.explanation: Cat and hat share the same ending sound: at.

steps.text: Say cat. Listen in the middle.
Say mat. It has the same middle sound.

try.question: Which word has the same middle sound as cat?
try.explanation: Cat and mat both have the short a sound in the middle.

phonics:5.title: Two letters can make one sound

steps.text: Listen at the start of ship.

try.question: Which letters make the first sound in ship?
try.explanation: The letters s and h work together to make /sh/.
